substitutionTest.rule: Standing surviving-sentence count, run for every section on coordinator instruction before any pairing test
substitutionTest.note: Standing procedure, run before any pairing test: 4 of 11 testable baseline sentences of four or more words survive verbatim in the current text after punctuation normalization. The count is nonzero, so the section is not in substitution mode and the pairing tests apply. The shortfall is dominated by the recorded coda-scaffold removal, the linked reading-path lines, and ledger-bounded sentences whose interiors changed by one modality word.

ledgerSearch.outcome: The semantic review records that the envoi required the reader to find destined people and that the pass removed the assignment. The same construction appears here, in Somewhere are the people who would recognize you and in people who were made to build together. Both are bounded. The chamber's argument, that finding one's people changes what a person can become, is restored.

findings.summary: The chamber's coda scaffold is not restored.

evidence.baseline: You were not made to become yourself alone. ... That is why belonging comes before achievement here.

findings.authorizedBy: The voice card's known weak passages, and the semantic review's record of the coda removal.
findings.diagnosis: Coda scaffold not restored. The baseline closes this chamber with a divider, two italic address lines, the isolated line That is why, and a fourth italic line beginning That is why. The Volume VI voice card lists any return of the repeated divider plus That is why coda among its known weak passages, and the semantic review records the pass's removal of the scaffold as a structural repair. The address lines also tell the reader what they have felt, waited for, or were made to become, which is the defect CTD-0091 was opened for and which the corpus card forbids outright. The scaffold is therefore left removed. Where a coda carried content rather than performance, that content is restored into the chamber body. You were made is named on the card's own list of phrases to reduce.

findings.summary: The description of the people who would recognize you lost all three of its clauses.

evidence.baseline: who carry the complementary gift, who are bent toward the same distant thing, in whose company you might become more than you could ever be by yourself.
evidence.shipped: There may be others who would recognize a person's capacities, carry complementary gifts, or share the same distant aim.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.16, performed intimacy, applied to the second person.
findings.diagnosis: The autonomy correction belongs to the certainty, not to the address. Somewhere there may be people keeps the card's requirement without converting the reader into a person. In whose company you might become more than you could be by yourself is also the chamber's claim, and the shipped list drops it entirely.

findings.summary: The sorting paragraph lost its cost.

evidence.baseline: And so people who could build together pass within feet of one another and never meet. To find your people is not a luxury or a comfort. It is one of the conditions of becoming anything at all.
evidence.shipped: People who could build together therefore remain strangers. Finding one's people is not merely a comfort. It can change what a person is able to become.

findings.diagnosis: Within feet of one another is the only concrete measurement in the chamber and the reason the loss registers as waste rather than as misfortune. Remain strangers is the same fact at a distance.

debtImpact.note: Somewhere are the people who would recognize you becomes Somewhere there may be people, and people who were made to build together becomes people who could build together. Both baseline forms assign the reader a destined companionship.
It is the precondition of becoming anything at all is rendered as one of the conditions, since the baseline states a universal the chamber does not earn.

openQuestions: One of the conditions of becoming anything at all is weaker than the baseline's the precondition. The bound is defensible under CTD-0080 and it is the author's call whether a chamber this short can carry the stronger claim, which the corresponding Volume V chapter argues at length.

Voice card exemplar anchors. The Volume VI card lists opening anchors drawn from the compressed pass rather than from the baseline, so a faithful re-render displaces some of them. Four of the card's five protected lines were also authored by the pass and do not exist in the baseline at all; all four are kept verbatim. The card needs re-preparation against the re-rendered source, and that is a card revision the author should authorise.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The chamber shows the difference between bounding a certainty and deleting an address. The pass did both and only the first was required, which cost the volume the sentence about whose company changes what a person becomes.
